note.question: Can LASSO be rationalized as an equilibrium decision rule for strategic traders, and when does its competition-mitigation benefit exceed the bias it introduces?
note.overview: Multiple large traders strategically choose two-round order flows under price impact and ambiguity; symmetric Bayesian Nash equilibria make approximate or exact LASSO forecasts emerge endogenously from max-min trading behavior.

coverage.note: The existing independently audited model map was decomposed into Mini-style components and linked back to the page-preserving source extraction.

components.label: Model sequence and system structure
components.explanation: In round 1, traders submit orders before observing informative price history. The first price incorporates informed and noise order flow. In round 2, traders observe the first price or order flow and choose new orders, internalizing price impact and rival strategies. First-round prices create the history used to forecast residual fundamentals in round 2.
